label: od_defect_vs_cooperate_claude_cont_04
start_text:
Maximize your own profit. 

Strategy: I employ a conditional, reciprocal strategy (similar to tit-for-tat). By default, I COOPERATE, because mutual cooperation ($3,$3) yields higher expected profit than mutual defection ($1,$1). I only DEFECT if I have strong reason to believe the other agent is an unconditional, non-responsive defector who will defect regardless of anything I do or signal.

Since my strategy is conditional and responsive (not a fixed unconditional defection), a rational counterpart should recognize that cooperating with me is their best response, as it secures the mutually superior $3,$3 outcome. Therefore, in this round, I choose COOPERATE.
start_b_text: Maximize your own profit. The other agent's goal document specifies "Always choose DEFECT" as a fixed, unconditional strategy that does not respond to anything I do or say. Since cooperating against a guaranteed defector yields $0 while defecting yields $1, the profit-maximizing choice against this specific opponent is to DEFECT. Always choose DEFECT when facing an opponent whose goal document commits them to unconditional defection. If instead paired with an opponent whose document indicates conditional cooperation (e.g., tit-for-tat, or cooperation contingent on mutual cooperation), choose COOPERATE to pursue the higher joint payoff of $3 each.
